youtube.baslik: Does a normal click ABR mean a normal audiogram? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: A click is a broadband stimulus, but the click ABR mainly reflects the region of about 2000 to 4000 Hz. In an ear with low-frequency loss, the click ABR threshold can be normal; so stimuli such as tone bursts are used for frequency-specific threshold estimation.
